en:
The BMW Connected Drive integration has been removed from Home Assistant.

In September 2025, BMW blocked third-party access to their servers by adding additional security measures. For EU-registered cars, a community-developed [custom component]({custom_component_url}) using BMW's CarData API is available as an alternative.

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your Home Assistant setup. [View your existing BMW Connected Drive integration entries]({entries}).
sv:
BMW Connected Drive-integrationen har tagits bort från Home Assistant.

I september 2025 blockerade BMW åtkomst från tredje part till sina servrar genom att införa ytterligare säkerhetsåtgärder. För bilar registrerade i EU finns en [anpassad komponent]({custom_component_url}) som utvecklats av communityn och använder BMW:s CarData API som alternativ.

Ta bort de inaktuella BMW Connected Drive-integrationsposterna från din Home Assistant-konfiguration för att lösa problemet. [Visa dina befintliga BMW Connected Drive-integrationsposter]({entries}).
verification_method: Lokalise API live readback + Home Assistant Core source review
